rules.title: App caches
rules.removes: Cached data apps keep in your Library's Caches folder, such as downloaded images and temporary indexes.
rules.keeps: Caches of apps that are running now, Apple's own caches and TidyMyMac's own files.
rules.notes: Apps re-create caches as needed. Apple caches are excluded until each one is reviewed on a real Mac.
evidence: Apple, File System Programming Guide, 'The Library Directory Stores App-Specific Files': the Caches folder holds data an app can re-create; the system may delete it to free space.

rules.title: Sandboxed app caches
rules.removes: Cached data sandboxed apps keep inside their containers.
rules.keeps: Everything else in each app's container, including its documents and settings.
rules.notes: Each container has its own Library/Caches folder. Reading containers needs Full Disk Access.
evidence: Apple, File System Programming Guide, 'The Library Directory Stores App-Specific Files': the Caches folder holds data an app can re-create; the system may delete it to free space.

rules.title: System caches
rules.removes: Caches in the computer-wide Library, shared by all users and system services.
rules.keeps: Apple's own caches, macOS components and TidyMyMac's own files.
rules.notes: Removed by the admin helper. Some apps rebuild these slowly, so items start unticked.
